backends_partial.ibm_kingston: 5 register-rule probes only (R10x2, R11x2, R12x2, split6, non-foldable overlap), 2026-11-16, backend_version 1.0.0; latency, stack-need shapes and fix-pack were not run there
backends_partial.ibm_fez: 5 register-rule probes only (R10x2, R11x2, R12x2, split6, non-foldable overlap), submitted 2026-11-15 and executed 2026-11-16, backend_version 1.3.37; latency, stack-need shapes and fix-pack were not run there

backend_coverage: ibm_marrakesh (all probes) + ibm_kingston and ibm_fez (5 register-rule probes each)
vector_definition: resources.resource_vector(circuit) on the circuit as shipped (executed transpiled circuit where the source says so); see resources.py

dimensions.peak_live_regs: registers (measured + register-valued stores) simultaneously live, maximum over the circuit
dimensions.peak_live_bitvars: bit-level stored variables simultaneously live, maximum over the circuit
dimensions.cone_regs: distinct measured registers in the cone
dimensions.total_reads: sum over stores in the cone of the distinct registers each reads (plus the if condition)
dimensions.stored_bits: total width in bits of the store targets in the cone
dimensions.max_store_ops: ops of the largest single stored expression in the cone (expanded)
dimensions.cond_ops: ops of the largest if-condition expression (expanded)
dimensions.cone_ops: total ops over the stores in the cone (expanded)
dimensions.depth: longest root-to-leaf chain of ops in a stored expression
dimensions.ershov: Sethi-Ullman register need of the largest stored expression
dimensions.lr_stack: left-to-right stack need of the largest stored expression
dimensions.distinct_leaf_bits: distinct measured bits / registers read by the cone's expressions
dimensions.leaf_refs: total leaf references in the cone's expressions
dimensions.unique_nodes: hash-consed (distinct) op nodes in the cone
dimensions.has_shift: 1 if a shift appears in a stored expression or condition
dimensions.has_add: 1 if an add or subtract appears
dimensions.unanalysed: count of conditions, stores or control-flow constructs the analysis could NOT fully follow (unknown condition form, unsupported lvalue, loops/switch/box, analysis error); any value > 0 can never be dominated by an accepted probe, so the verdict is never PASS

verdict_rule.PASS: vector <= the vector of some ACCEPTED probe in every dimension of pass_dims; never PASS if unanalysed > 0 or the circuit has no if (monotonicity is an ASSUMPTION)
verdict_rule.FAIL: vector >= the vector of some REJECTED probe in every dimension of fail_dims
verdict_rule.CONTRADICTION: both (never occurs on the stored probes)

leave_one_out_basis: UNIQUE (vector, class) pairs (identical replicates removed); computed on all data, so descriptive, not out-of-sample
caveats: measured on ibm_marrakesh; only the 5 register-rule probes were replicated on ibm_kingston and ibm_fez (identical outcomes, three backend versions 1.0.21 / 1.0.0 / 1.3.37; both executed 2026-11-16); latency, stack-need shapes and fix-pack were measured only on ibm_marrakesh. Dates in the project: four (2026-11-16: the kingston and fez replications; 2026-11-06: the 29 'old' probes, 25 accepted and 4 rejected, run once and never repeated; 2026-11-09: the legacy latency ladder, not part of this envelope; 2026-11-15: everything else)

the headline counts (accepted, rejected, unique, leave-one-out) are over the ibm_marrakesh probes; the kingston and fez probes are shipped in the envelope as replicates (their vectors equal those of the marrakesh p3 probes) and do not change a verdict
monotonicity is an assumption: the stored probes do not contradict it but 29 rejected probes cannot prove it
the failure dimensions and the leave-one-out were chosen/computed on ALL the data (descriptive, not out-of-sample); only data/v1, data/e1, data/e2 are frozen out-of-sample rounds
probes rejected with another code (6066, fix-pack) are excluded from this envelope
a vector takes the elementwise MAX over the cones of all ifs and the circuit-wide peak of live registers; the backend may count differently
PASS needs domination in ALL dimensions, so many realistic circuits are UNCERTAIN; that is intended (conservative)
